Quectel BG95 Series AT Commands Manual - OLD SEMANTIC SAMPLE

6.1 AT+QCFGTEST Configure Test Mode
Write Command
AT+QCFGTEST=<mode>[,<timeout>]
Response
+QCFGTEST: <mode>,<timeout>
Parameter
<mode> Integer type. Range: 0-2.
- 0 Disabled
- 1 Normal
- 2 Extended
<timeout> Integer type. Range: 1-255.

6.2 AT+QMODE Configure Mode
Write Command
AT+QMODE=<mode>
Response
+QMODE: <mode>
Parameter
<mode> Integer type.
- 0 Automatic
- 1 Manual
- 2 Legacy

6.3 AT+QWINDOW Configure Window
Write Command
AT+QWINDOW=<window>
Response
+QWINDOW: <window>
Parameter
<window> Integer type. Range: 1-255.
